description: Inspect custom tables in one or more data models and flag the use of UNION.

datamodels.description: One or more data model references to analyze. Each reference can be: - a Sisense data model ID, or - a data model title (name). At least one data model reference is required. At runtime this method is tolerant of a single string being passed instead of a list, and will normalize it to a one-element list.

examples.user_query: Check if any custom tables in the 'Sales Analytics' data model use UNION.
examples.notes: This call inspects the 'Sales Analytics' data model by its title and flags any custom tables that use UNION in their SQL expressions.

examples.user_query: Analyze custom tables in multiple data models for UNION usage.
examples.notes: This call checks three data models: two by their IDs ('12345' and '67890') and one by its title ('Marketing Insights'). It identifies custom tables with UNION in their SQL expressions.

examples.user_query: Inspect the custom tables in the data model with ID 'abc123'.
examples.notes: This call analyzes the data model identified by the ID 'abc123' and flags any custom tables that use UNION in their SQL expressions.
